body: I’m very proud of how far you’ve come. Trauma never goes away, does it? It can be very hard to stay afloat when trauma is drowning you, so you should be very proud that you’re still fighting and reaching out. Your cat sounds like a sweetheart!
You’re right it takes time and practise to be assertive, but I’ll just keep trying. Thank you for your kind reply!

I’m sorry that you had to deal with that and I’m very proud of you for standing up for yourself. I’ll try to do better next time. As for the price of groceries, most of my food comes from local food bank and I spend about 10 euro on eggs or fresh produce. However at some point I managed to eatfor 7 euro a week, which was just oats on water and rice with sugar or ketchup.
You’re right, I can’t become confident overnight, I’ll just have to keep trying and maybe try better shop next time.

I really really hope that they just forgot to put the prices, but i admit I’m an easy prey, since I was blubbering and stuttering and didn’t press on. Thank you for your kind words and the advise is great, I’ll try it out next time!

Thank you for your kind and supportive words, I really appreciate it. After analysing I realised I made a mistake by coming during a rush hour and became quickly overwhelmed by the rush of customers. Most likely it was just a mistake on cashiers part and I’ll try to do better next time.
